# open62541 / fuzz_binary_decode

open62541's own fuzz target `fuzz_binary_decode` ([source](source/fuzz_binary_decode.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over open62541 (open62541/open62541 at 12b72510).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, an API contract: UA_copy of any value UA_decodeBinary accepted (random type index over all UA_TYPES) compares UA_ORDER_EQ to the original under UA_order (full deep comparison).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against open62541 at commit 12b72510.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- UA_copy of any value UA_decodeBinary accepted (random type index over all UA_TYPES) compares UA_ORDER_EQ to the original under UA_order (full deep comparison) ([lines 68-76](source/fuzz_binary_decode.cc#L68-L76)): assert(); compiled out.
